mapper.select: SELECT share_id, field_id, readable, writable, hidden, mask_strategy_id FROM iam_share_field_grant_projection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} AND share_id IN #{id} ORDER BY share_id, field_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_share_acl_projection ( id, tenant_id, share_id, resource_id, resource_instance_key, target_type, target_id, operation_id, start_time, expire_time, status, projection_epoch, scope_type, folder_path, collection_resource_ids_json, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{shareId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceInstanceKey}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{operationId}, #{startTime}, #{expireTime}, 'ACTIVE', #{projectionEpoch}, #{scopeType}, #{folderPath}, #{collectionResourceIdsJson}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE resource_id = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(resource_id), resource_id), resource_instance_key = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(resource_instance_key), resource_instance_key), start_time = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(start_time), start_time), expire_time = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(expire_time), expire_time), scope_type = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(scope_type), scope_type), folder_path = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(folder_path), folder_path), collection_resource_ids_json = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(collection_resource_ids_json), collection_resource_ids_json), status = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, 'ACTIVE', status), version = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, version + 1, version), updated_at = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), projection_epoch = GREATEST(projection_epoch, VALUES(projection_epoch))

INSERT INTO iam_share_field_grant_projection ( id, tenant_id, share_id, operation_id, field_id, readable, writable, hidden, mask_strategy_id, projection_epoch, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{shareId}, #{operationId}, #{fieldId}, #{readable}, #{writable}, #{hidden}, #{maskStrategyId}, #{projectionEpoch}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE readable = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(readable), readable), writable = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(writable), writable), hidden = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(hidden), hidden), mask_strategy_id = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(mask_strategy_id), mask_strategy_id), updated_at = IF(VALUES(projection_epoch) > projection_epoch, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), projection_epoch = GREATEST(projection_epoch, VALUES(projection_epoch))

INSERT INTO iam_share_security_epoch ( tenant_id, resource_id, expected_epoch, applied_epoch, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{epoch}, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expected_epoch = GREATEST(expected_epoch, VALUES(expected_epoch)), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO iam_share_security_epoch ( tenant_id, resource_id, expected_epoch, applied_epoch, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{epoch}, #{epoch}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE applied_epoch = GREATEST(applied_epoch, VALUES(applied_epoch)), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
